canonical_project: NAVER Data Center GAK Sejong (incl. 2nd/3rd phase AI expansion)
notes: GAK Sejong (Buyong-myeon) launched 2023-11-08 and is operational; NAVER started phase 2/3 construction at end-2025, acquiring 60,000 next-gen Blackwell GPUs and targeting 270MW total campus scale by 2029 as Asia's largest AI hub (AI factory capacity cited growing from 55MW to 200MW+; campus total 270MW per DCD/DataCenterMap). Official NAVER release (A) plus ETNews/Hankyung (B) coverage.
